Tooltip_CRV_BedHint: A good bed: sit in a front seat and Sleep (V)
Tooltip_CRV_Armour_Magazine: Welded plate, expanded-metal mesh and arch guards for the Honda CRV: teaches how to make every piece of CRV survival armor.
Tooltip_CRV_Awning_Item:
A roll-out side awning for the CRV's roof rails.
Rolled out beside a parked car, it keeps the rain off whoever stands under it.
Tooltip_CRV_Awning_Moving: The car must be standing still
Tooltip_CRV_Awning_Inside: Get out of the car first
Tooltip_Recipe_HondaCRVKnowHow: How the first CRV goes together: more Mechanics experience from work on a CRV.
Tooltip_CRV_Function_Manual:
Honda's owner's manual for the first CRV.
Reading it teaches Basic Mechanics, and how this car goes together:
more Mechanics experience from work on a CRV.
Tooltip_CRV_Lift_Kit: A 3 in. suspension lift for the Honda CRV: longer springs, spacers, shocks, four 30x9.50R15 all-terrain tires and a set of black steel wheels.
Tooltip_CRV_Lift_Magazine: Teaches how to build a lift kit for a compact SUV.
Tooltip_CRV_Lift_Passengers: Everybody out of the car first
Tooltip_CRV_Lift_Key: Take the key out of the ignition and off the door
Tooltip_CRV_Lift_Ground: Needs open ground or a parking spot
Tooltip_CRV_Lift_Busy: Everybody else stand back from the car
Tooltip_CRV_Lift_Time: Takes a long time. The kit comes back when the lift is removed.
